chunks: And among them is Faris ibn Hatim ibn Mahuya al-Qazwini:
ai.seo_question: Who is Faris ibn Hatim al-Qazwini in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: Faris ibn Hatim al-Qazwini is identified in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* as one of the four prominent emissaries (al-Nuwwab al-Arba’a) of Imam al-Hasan al-Askari, whose collective dismissal marked the transition to the Minor Ghaiba. His inclusion in the list of condemned emissaries highlights the theological significance of the 'Four Deputies' era, where their authority served as a bridge between the Imam’s occultation and the eventual return.
